# nico_site (Resource)

Site is a datacenter that contains physical hardware and networking resources. All resources created by Provider or Tenant are directly or indirectly anchored to the Site object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_site" "example" {
  name                           = "name-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name for the Site

### Optional

- `capabilities` (Attributes) Modify Site capabilities. Can only be updated by Provider. Partial update allowed, only specify capabilities that should be updated. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--capabilities))
- `contact` (Attributes) Site contact information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contact))
- `description` (String) Description for the Site
- `is_serial_console_enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable Serial Console. Can only be updated by Provider. Modifying this attribute has no actual effect on SOL. It will be removed in a future API version.
- `is_serial_console_ssh_keys_enabled` (Boolean) Enable/disable Serial Console access using SSH Keys. Previously updateable only by Tenants, modifying this value is no longer supported, update SSH Key Groups to remove Site instead.
- `location` (Attributes) Site location information (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--location))
- `renew_registration_token` (Boolean) Set to true to issue a new registration token. Can only be updated by Provider
- `serial_console_hostname` (String) Hostname to reach Serial Console for the Site
- `serial_console_idle_timeout` (Number) Maximum idle time in seconds before Serial Console is disconnected. Can only be updated by Provider. Modifying this attribute has no actual effect on SOL. It will be removed in a future API version.
- `serial_console_max_session_length` (Number) Maximum length of Serial Console session in seconds. Can only be updated by Provider. Modifying this attribute has no actual effect on SOL. It will be removed in a future API version.
- `site_id` (String) Path parameter: site_id.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the Site was created
- `gpu_stats` (Attributes List) GPU counts grouped by GPU type for the Site. Populated when includeGpuStats is set (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--gpu_stats))
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Site
- `is_online` (Boolean) Indicates if the Site is currently reachable from Cloud
- `machine_stats` (Attributes) Machine counts by status for the Site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--machine_stats))
- `org` (String) NGC organization ID of the Infrastructure Provider that owns the Site
- `registration_token` (String) Token that can be used to register a Site. Value only exposed to Provider
- `registration_token_expiration` (String) Date/time when registration token expires. Value only exposed to Provider
- `site_agent_version` (String) Version of the Site Agent software
- `site_controller_version` (String) Version of the Site Controller software
- `status` (String) Status of the Site
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the Site (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Site was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--capabilities"></a>
### Nested Schema for `capabilities`

Read-Only:

- `dps_power_management` (Boolean) Enable or disable DPS power management for the Site. Omission or `null` preserves the current value. Only Providers can update this field.
- `image_based_operating_system` (Boolean) Enable or disable image-based operating system support for the Site
- `native_networking` (Boolean) Enable or disable native networking for the Site
- `network_security_group` (Boolean) Enable or disable network security groups for the Site
- `nv_link_partition` (Boolean) Enable or disable NVLink partition support for the Site

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the Site contact

Read-Only:
